We need to produce JSON with summary (<=80 words), next_steps (3 strings), criteria for C1-C4 each <=70 words. Address student as "you". Be specific, cite sections/figures, name what they did well, state next rubric level requirements. Don't change marks. Don't comment on conversion artefacts. Don't make up explanations for unclear reasoning.

Need to be supportive and actionable. Mention specific issues: inclination 87.79° prograde vs SSO ~97.8°, Kourou latitude 45.05°N vs ~5.2°N, contact duration 20 min vs 580.8 s table, RAAN assertion, no mass/area/drag sail sizing, Vega E reliance, sensor requirements not quantified, users not explicit, conclusion restatement, presentation unnumbered figures/tables, Wikipedia citation, bare URLs.

Need to phrase per criterion. C1: well argued mission purpose and single-sat justification; next level requires explicit operator/customer definitions and complete referencing. C2: covers all elements with STK evidence; next level requires correcting inclination, launch latitude, contact stats, adding sensor/swath/GSD calculations, STK files, target coverage, EOL mass/drag sizing, justify launch vehicle. C4: clear structure/readable; next level requires numbered captions, labelled tables, proper reference list, remove Wikipedia, cite all claims.

Summary <=80 words: "Your report is readable and logically structured, and you cover all major design elements with STK evidence. The main weaknesses are numerical: the 87.79° inclination is prograde and inconsistent with a 600 km sun-synchronous orbit (~97.8°), Kourou's latitude is ~5.2°N not 45.05°N, and your 20-minute contact claim contradicts the 580.8 s table. Presentation and referencing also need work." That's about 70 words. Good.

Next steps 3 strings: actionable. 1) Recompute/verify SSO inclination and launch-site latitude; reconcile contact duration with table and explain min 151 s access constraint. 2) Add sensor/GSD/swath/FOV and downlink budget calculations, include STK files and target-coverage analysis; size EOL drag sail/mass and re-entry timeline. 3) Fix presentation: number/caption figures and tables, replace bare URLs/Wikipedia with proper references, explicitly define operator/customers, and make conclusion draw quantified outcomes.

Need criteria strings <=70 words each. Let's craft.

C1: "You argue the fluid-lensing reef/ocean mission need well and justify a single satellite with references. To reach Accomplished, explicitly define the operator and customers (e.g., who tasks, owns, and receives data) rather than implying them, and ensure all introduction claims are referenced." ~50 words.

C2: "You cover launch, orbit, ground control, communications, duration and EOL with STK screenshots. To reach Accomplished, correct the 87.79° prograde inclination to ~97.8° for a 600 km SSO, fix Kourou's latitude to ~5.2°N, and reconcile the 20-minute contact claim with your 580.8 s table. Add GSD/swath/FOV and downlink calculations, STK files, target-coverage analysis, and drag-sail sizing/re-entry timeline." ~65 words. Good.

C3: "Your conclusion restates launch, orbit, ground station and EOL, and notes the Vega E fallback. To reach Accomplished, draw quantified conclusions from your analysis—revisit frequency, contact time, data volume—and acknowledge the inclination error and launch-vehicle immaturity as caveats rather than only restating choices." ~50 words.

C4: "Your structure, executive summary and prose are clear. To reach Accomplished, number and caption all figures and tables consistently, replace bare/broken URLs and the Wikipedia entry with properly formatted references, and cite every claim (e.g., solar panels extending life). Ensure in-text citations match the reference list." ~50 words.

Need JSON only. Ensure valid JSON. Use criterion ids C1 etc. Summary <=80 words. Next_steps exactly 3 strings. Criteria object with keys C1-C4. No markdown. Let's produce.
